g.text: 01 / PROMOTIONGUARD
An AI agent-governance system built for a hackathon's agent-security track. An autonomous agent runs a full ML
model-promotion pipeline unattended, but every action is checked against a cryptographically signed execution
plan instead of a keyword filter — unauthorized calls get hard-blocked or routed to human approval, with a full
audit trail. Deployed as a live interactive demo.
PYTHON · AI AGENT GOVERNANCE · ML PIPELINE SAFETY · LIVE DEMO
02 / SANN
A training-loop auditor that detects data leakage, memorization, shortcut learning, and poisoning attacks in
real time during model training — instead of catching problems after the fact. Benchmarked against academic
datasets (Waterbirds, BadNets-CIFAR, ciFAIR) with a full feature-ablation study. In progress.
PYTHON · PYTORCH · MODEL AUDITING · ML SAFETY RESEARCH
03 / KSP CRIME INTELLIGENCE
Built for the Zoho Catalyst Datathon 2026 in partnership with Karnataka State Police. A natural-language
interface over a crime database that answers investigator questions in plain language, backed by a RandomForest
offender-risk classifier with SHAP-based explanations and counterfactual generation. Deployed on Zoho Catalyst.
PYTHON · NLP · SHAP · RANDOMFOREST · ZOHO CATALYST · DATATHON 2026
04 / GALLASAATHI
A voice-first AI copilot for Indian kirana shopkeepers, built for the Gemma Hackathon (Kaggle, Track “Vaani”).
Understands code-switched Hindi/Punjabi/English voice commands for udhaar (credit), ledger, and inventory
tracking, using Gemma fine-tuned via LoRA — with a trust layer that stops and asks for clarification instead
of guessing when confidence is low.
TYPESCRIPT · GEMMA · LORA FINE-TUNING · VOICE AI · MULTILINGUAL
05 / DEVLENS
An AI onboarding navigator for unfamiliar codebases. Maps GitHub issues to code using hybrid vector search
(AWS Titan v2 + ChromaDB), mines PR history to explain why code exists, and includes a multilingual
jargon-simplifier for Hindi, Tamil, and Hinglish. 1st Runner-Up, VisionX Hackathon (GeeksforGeeks).
PYTHON · RAG · AWS TITAN V2 · CHROMADB · 1ST RUNNER-UP
06 / BUNDLEFLOW
A Web3 reimagining of Splitwise for gasless micro-payments, built on Aptos. React/TypeScript app with Petra
wallet integration, QR-code group joining, and gasless batch settlement via the SmoothSend SDK.
Winner, SmoothSend Sponsorship Track — Ctrl+Alt+Vibe (MSIT).
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · APTOS · PETRA WALLET · SMOOTHSEND SDK
07 / CREATOR_X
A Web3/AI marketplace where each creator has a tradeable ERC-1155 “Fan Pass” token, priced by an on-chain
bonding curve that's continuously modulated by an off-chain NLP sentiment engine tracking creator engagement.
Includes scheduled trading windows, per-creator circuit breakers, and a Flutter app with live candlestick charts.
SOLIDITY · ERC-1155 · BONDING CURVE · NLP SENTIMENT · FLUTTER
08 / DEBATEMIND
A multi-agent debate simulator where a reinforcement-learning-coached debater faces off against a static
opponent LLM, judged in real time on logic, relevance, clarity, and persuasiveness. The RL agent (epsilon-greedy
bandit) picks a new argument strategy each round based on the judge's score, with a dashboard visualizing the
learning curve over the debate.
PYTHON · REINFORCEMENT LEARNING · MULTI-AGENT AI · LLM JUDGE
